# A spread into a slot insertion runs on the interpreter, which executes the
# checked IR with no lowering. The checker expands `...r` into the named
# arguments its fields are, so no ir.Spread reaches SlotInst.Args and the
# interpreter needs no arm for one. testdata/spread_slot_insertion.txtar runs
# the same program on the five compiled targets.

sngl test --platform none spread.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

-- spread.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

struct Row {
    title string
    count int
    unused bool = false
}

struct Partial {
    title string
}

component whole(r Row, cell component(title string, count int)) node {
    vbox {
        cell(...r)
    }
}

component mixed(p Partial, cell component(title string, count int)) node {
    vbox {
        cell(count=7, ...p)
    }
}

component main node {
    var seen = ""
    whole(r=Row{title="row", count=3}) {
        component cell(t, n) {
            button #a(text=t, @click { seen = seen + t + string(n) + ";" })
        }
    }
    mixed(p=Partial{title="part"}) {
        component cell(t, n) {
            button #b(text=t, @click { seen = seen + t + string(n) + ";" })
        }
    }
}

func testSpreadIntoSlot(t Test, c main) {
    c.a.click()
    c.b.click()
    t.assert(c.seen == "row3;part7;")
}
